subject: I dance on the fence, with the...
author: SUFFUR
body:
...fiddle of the horned one on one side and the beauty of the Angels, tempting me on the other, but since IMHO and have blogged it, they don't exsist, I'm just an Idiot  on a fence, with no music 'cept the beating of my stone heart, and people watching as they drive by.

You know last year I was walking along the road when some kids, supposedly young adults, in a car, buzzed me with an unopened can of drink, just missed my head as I heard it coming, hit the wall, made a mess. The funny thing was the young driver only just passed his test, and his instructor coming the other way saw it, and pulled up beside me, to sort it out, by phoning the 911, and later when I went out for a drink with friends, saw the "young adults",  one nursing a broken bloody nose, the others looking like going home due to a bad night, and it was only 8PM, I like Karma.

I was not really bothered, as I avoided it, just a waste of a cold drink, IMO.

Not bothered what side you're on, you have done me no harm, or anyone I know. In truth I like you, or is that to be honest I like you, sexual probuscuss?

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?
